summary.interpretationNote: All-observation sigma and displacement describe the full trace. Stationary statistics include only labeled, pointer-active frames and are computed within uninterrupted stationary segments; inactive/lost frames and transitions are excluded. A declared purpose does not provide target coordinates. Target and task metrics require recorded ground-truth annotations. Inference timing, CPU, memory, and mailbox drops are unavailable when not captured.
